name: Station Clock
description: An analogue wall clock with bar markers, a sweeping second hand and a minute hand that steps once a minute.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: An IANA time zone such as "Asia/Tokyo". Defaults to the visitor's own. The clock reads the time after it mounts; before that it shows 10:09:36 so the server and the browser agree, then the hands swing round to the real time.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels. Markers and hands keep a minimum width so the dial stays crisp from about 96 pixels up; below 72 the minute ticks are left out. It shrinks to fit a narrower container.

props.name: label
props.description: Caption beneath the dial, such as a city. A string label also names the clock for assistive technology, which hears the time as well.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Show the second hand, which sweeps continuously. The minute hand steps forward once a minute with a small overshoot either way; without seconds the clock only redraws at each minute. Under reduced motion the second hand ticks once a second and the minute hand steps without overshoot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the figure. Other figure props are passed through.
